html:
Gaafar Nimeiry was the military ruler and president of Sudan from his coup in May 1969 until he was overthrown in April 1985.

He began as a socialist and Arab nationalist, crushed the Communists and the religious Ansar, and in 1972 ended the first civil war by granting the south autonomy. Later he allied with the Islamists of Hassan al-Turabi.

In 1983 he divided the south and imposed Islamic law across the country in the September Laws, with public amputations. Southern troops mutinied, starting the second civil war. Strikes and protests in 1985, during a famine, led the army to remove him while he was abroad, in Sudan's second popular uprising.
